{{External|rs|rsc=Oak Shortbow|dw=Oak Shortbow}} {{Infobox Item |name = Oak shortbow |image = [[File:Oak shortbow.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A shortbow made out of oak, still effective. |value = 100 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 843 }} [[File:Oak shortbow detail.png|left|130px]] The '''oak shortbow''' is a shortbow stronger than the [[shortbow|standard shortbow]] that can use arrows up to [[steel arrows|steel]]. It requires a [[Ranged]] level of 5 or higher to wield. Oak shortbows can be made at level 20 [[Fletching]] by using a [[knife]] on [[oak logs]] to cut them into an [[oak shortbow (u)]], granting 16.5 Fletching experience. Then, the player must string the [[Oak shortbow (u)|unstrung oak shortbow]] with a [[bow string]], granting another 16.5 experience. Fletching an oak shortbow in the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] is a requirement for the [[Easy Western Provinces Diary]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +14 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 4 |attackrange = 7 |combatstyle = Bow |image = [[File:Oak shortbow equipped.png]] |altimage = [[File:Oak shortbow equipped female.png|150px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=4|attackrange=7}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Fletching |skill1lvl = 20 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 16.5 |members = Yes |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Oak shortbow (u) |mat2 = Bow string |output1 = Oak shortbow }} ==Products== {{Uses material list|Oak shortbow}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Oak shortbow}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Oak shortbow}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Oak shortbow|location=[[Civitas illa Fortis]] {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}|members=Yes|1711,3112|plane=2|leagueRegion = Varlamore}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 26 January 2005 |update = Slayer Skill |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Oak shortbow detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Oak shortbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Oak shortbow (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Oak shortbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
